nodes.one_liner_zh: 引号短语与锚点验证过的精确命中在最终排序里整体提前
nodes.one_liner_en: Quoted phrases and anchor-verified exact hits jump the queue
nodes.professional_zh: 精确命中（引号短语、锚点契约验证过的）在最终排序里整体提前，按精确等级排。语义分再高也不能把「逐字出现」压下去——混合打分管相关性，精确等级管确定性，两条规则分工不混。
nodes.professional_en: Exact hits (quoted phrases, anchor-contract-verified) are promoted as a block in the final ordering, by exactness grade. No semantic score can push a verbatim occurrence down: hybrid scoring owns relevance, the exactness grade owns certainty — two rules, two jobs.
nodes.plain_zh: 你打引号就是要逐字。逐字出现的结果永远排在「意思差不多」前面，不管语义模型多喜欢后者。
nodes.plain_en: Quotes mean verbatim. Anything containing the exact string outranks everything that merely resembles it — no matter how much the embedding model likes the other file.
nodes.example_zh: search '"z_gate=3.0"' --db evals/eval.sqlite：含这个逐字串的文件排最前，语义近亲排后面。
nodes.example_en: search '"z_gate=3.0"' --db evals/eval.sqlite — files containing the literal string come first; semantic cousins follow.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 同一文件近似度 0.97 以上的段落只展示一条
nodes.one_liner_en: Segments of the same file above cos 0.97 collapse into one row
nodes.professional_zh: 渲染层把同一文件的近重复段落折叠：余弦 0.97 以上的近似段只展一条主记录，其余收进该行。目标是屏幕密度而不是召回——折叠发生在排序与预算之后，--json 保留全量供程序消费。
nodes.professional_en: The render layer folds near-duplicate segments within a file: segments above cosine 0.97 collapse into the top record. It trades screen density, not recall — folding happens after ranking and budgeting, and --json keeps everything for programs.
nodes.plain_zh: 同一份文件里五段长得几乎一样的话，人只想看一次。机器搜到了五段的事实不变，屏幕上只给你看一条。
nodes.plain_en: If one file has five nearly identical passages, you want to see one. All five were found; the screen shows one; the JSON has five.
nodes.example_zh: 对同一文件反复出现同一术语的长手册做 search，人读模式每文件近重复段只占一行。
nodes.example_en: Search a long manual reusing one phrase — human mode shows one row per near-dup cluster.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 低于 0.5×榜首分数的命中整行折叠，实测从未折掉预期答案
nodes.one_liner_en: Hits below 0.5× the top score fold away; never once folded the expected answer
nodes.professional_zh: 继承自 DigUp 的实测规则：分数低于榜首 0.5 倍的命中在 human 模式整行折叠（DigUp 实测 26.2→5.7 条/查询，从未折掉预期答案）；--json 模式保留全量。折叠只影响人读输出，不碰排序、预算与程序接口。
nodes.professional_en: Inherited from DigUp's measurement: in human mode, hits scoring under 0.5× the leader fold away (DigUp measured 26.2→5.7 rows/query and never folded the expected answer); --json keeps everything. Folding touches human output only — ranking, budgets and program interfaces are untouched.
nodes.plain_zh: 分数不到第一名一半的结果，多半是凑数的。人读输出里把它们收起来，但机器（--json）仍然全量可查——藏是藏给你看的，不是藏事实。
nodes.plain_en: Results scoring under half the leader are usually noise. Human output hides them; --json never does — hidden from eyes, not from programs.
nodes.example_zh: docs/ANCHORS.md 第 2 条场景里加 --json 对比 human 输出，行数差异就是这条规则在工作。
nodes.example_en: Run the ANCHORS #2 scenario with and without --json — the row-count delta is this rule working.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 命中文件的类型匹配给 +1.0 平坦加成，封顶不叠加
nodes.one_liner_en: A matching file-kind adds a flat +1.0, capped, never stacked
nodes.professional_zh: 融合分里的类型项：命中文件的 kind 与查询暗示的类型一致时加 1.0——平坦、封顶、不叠加，避免类型成为第二个语义分。lookup 型查询下类型项随权重反转为 (0.5, 4.0) 里的固定部分。DigUp 曾实测「code 词权 2.0→1.0」的收益，但 goldmine 自己的 A/B（85 文件、21 题）显示混合词法已饱和（s@5=1.000），按纪律不采——记录在 digup-derived-plan §5。
nodes.professional_en: The kind term in the fusion score: when the hit's kind matches the query's implied type, +1.0 — flat, capped, never stacked, so kind can't become a second semantic score. Under lookup queries it rides the inverted (0.5, 4.0) weights. DigUp measured a gain from re-weighting code terms, but goldmine's own A/B (85 files, 21 queries) showed lexical matching already saturates (s@5=1.000) — recorded, not adopted (digup-derived-plan §5).
nodes.plain_zh: 问代码时代码文件加一分固定分——只是一分，不搞复利。DigUp 的同款调参在我们这复测为零收益，按「别处有效≠这里有效」的规矩放弃。
nodes.plain_en: Code queries give code files one flat point — no compounding. DigUp's same tweak re-measured as zero here; 'worked elsewhere' is not evidence here.
nodes.example_zh: search 'parse config' --kind code --db …：--kinds 过滤是显式版，类型提示是打分里的隐式版。
nodes.example_en: search 'parse config' --kind code — --kinds is the explicit filter; kind hints are the implicit scoring version.

nodes.one_liner_zh: --multi-query 把原查询加最多两个来源派生子句，规则生成不用 AI 猜
nodes.one_liner_en: --multi-query adds up to two source-derived clauses — rules, not AI guesses
nodes.professional_zh: quality 模式可选开关（默认关）：原查询之外，由确定性规则从已命中来源派生最多两个子句再查一遍合并。派生是语法级的、可复现的——同样的输入永远同样的子句，这使它能进评测。复合问题的收益尚未测得，故保持默认关闭。
nodes.professional_en: An optional quality-mode switch (off by default): beyond the original query, deterministic rules derive at most two clauses from already-hit sources and merge the results. Derivation is grammatical and reproducible — same input, same clauses — which is what makes it evaluable. Compound-question benefit is unmeasured, so it stays off.
nodes.plain_zh: 第一遍没找全时，从已找到的文件里反推出两个「换个问法」再搜一轮。关键是换法是规则定的，不是模型自由发挥——不然测都没法测。
nodes.plain_en: When round one misses, derive two reformulations from what did hit and search again. The reformulations come from rules, not model free-styling — otherwise you couldn't measure them.
nodes.example_zh: search 'why does admission reject' --mode quality --multi-query --db …：JSON 输出里能看到派生子句。
nodes.example_en: search 'why does admission reject' --mode quality --multi-query — the JSON shows the derived clauses.
nodes.analogy_zh: 第一遍没找到，换个问法再问一次——换法写死在规则里
nodes.analogy_en: Ask again, rephrased — the rephrasing is rulebook-fixed

nodes.one_liner_zh: 可选的钉版 639MB 重排模型，只对前 20 条入选段重排，默认关
nodes.one_liner_en: An optional pinned 639MB reranker reorders the top-20 admitted segments; off by default
nodes.professional_zh: quality 模式可选（--rerank local，默认关）：钉版 639MB 交叉编码器，只对准入后的前 20 段、每段 384 token 重排。六个真实端点探针与有界输入/清理测试已过；开发 A/B 与资源门未跑完，所以不默认开——证据没齐的开关不替用户做主。
nodes.professional_en: Optional in quality mode (--rerank local, off by default): a pinned 639MB cross-encoder reranks only the top-20 admitted segments at 384 tokens each. Six real endpoint probes and bounded-input/cleanup tests pass; the dev A/B and resource gates haven't run, so it ships off — an unproven switch doesn't get to default on.
nodes.plain_zh: 第二名愿意请一位更挑剔的评委来重打分——但这位评委 639MB，请一次不便宜，所以默认不请。
nodes.plain_en: A pickier judge re-scores the finalists — but the judge is 639MB and slow to summon, so by default nobody calls it.
nodes.example_zh: search '退款条款' --mode quality --rerank local --db …：对比开关前后的排序差异。
nodes.example_en: search '退款条款' --mode quality --rerank local — diff the ordering with it on and off.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 本地重排器可以在同文件内改判证据窗口，2026-10-26 落地，cjk@5 0.77→0.87
nodes.one_liner_en: The local reranker may re-decide the evidence window within a file; landed 2026-10-26, cjk@5 0.77→0.87
nodes.professional_zh: rank-window-001（提交 863fcb7）：在入选文件内部，若主证据来自普通语义阶梯，本地 Qwen3-Reranker 可在词法共资格的候选窗（单元数 ≥ 主证据、按句单元浓度排序）中改判——改判需要 0.01 分差领先；Tier-1/2 窗口结论永不被推翻；只在 pack 构建请求武装（裸列表搜索与时延基准不开）；重排器按 (server, model) 记忆化，评测循环共享一个懒拉起的子进程。013 真库回放：cjk@5 0.7667→0.8667、semantic@5 0.80→0.8667，双双过 0.85 门。
nodes.professional_en: rank-window-001 (commit 863fcb7): inside an admitted file whose primary came from the plain semantic ladder, a local Qwen3-Reranker may re-decide the window among lexically co-qualified candidates (unit count ≥ the primary's, ordered by sentence-unit concentration); takeover needs a 0.01 score lead; Tier-1/2 window verdicts are never overturned; it arms only for pack-building requests (bare listing searches and the latency bench stay off); the reranker is memoized per (server, model) so evaluation loops share one lazily-spawned child. Real-code replay on the 013 index: cjk@5 0.7667→0.8667, semantic@5 0.80→0.8667 — both past the 0.85 gate.
nodes.plain_zh: 语义模型有时被「标题党」段落吸走，真正答案挤在同文件另一段。现在允许一位更仔细的评委在同文件内改判「给你看哪段」——但只改判这一件事，且必须有分差优势才许改。
nodes.plain_en: Semantic models occasionally fall for a clickbait segment while the answer sits in the next one. A stricter judge may now overturn which segment you see — within the same file, only that one decision, and only with a score lead.
nodes.example_zh: scripts/eval_real.py 的 013 回放记录在提交 863fcb7 的提交说明里；pack 输出中同文件的证据窗与关掉仲裁的版本对比可复现该增益。
nodes.example_en: The 013 replay is recorded in commit 863fcb7's message; diffing pack output with arbitration on/off reproduces the gain.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 把 100 篇混主题文档自动聚成主题卡片，原文逐字、增量更新
nodes.one_liner_en: Auto-cluster 100 mixed-topic documents into verbatim excerpt cards; incremental updates
nodes.professional_zh: distill 命令：v3 共现集成、默认 τ=0.45（可手动覆盖或增量继承）、卡片只收逐字原文、schema v4 携带 fp16 质心。mock 评测：v1 规则 purity 0.120 FAIL vs v2 purity 0.880 / ARI 0.812 / 主题找回 8-of-8 PASS。真实 120 文档输入已冻结并独立审计；真实聚类质量跑分仍欠——机制与质量分开记账。
nodes.professional_en: The distill command: a v3 co-occurrence ensemble, default τ=0.45 (manual override or inherited incremental), cards hold verbatim original text only, schema v4 carries fp16 centroids. Mock eval: v1 rule purity 0.120 FAIL vs v2 purity 0.880 / ARI 0.812 / topic recovery 8-of-8 PASS. The real 120-document inputs are frozen and independently audited; the real clustering quality run is still owed — mechanics and quality are booked separately.
nodes.plain_zh: 把一堆杂七杂八的文档按内容自动归堆，每堆给你一张「原句卡片」。归堆规则换 v2 时旧规则打 0.12 分——红就是红，记录在案才换的。
nodes.plain_en: Auto-pile mixed documents into topic piles and hand you a card of verbatim quotes per pile. When the rule went v1→v2, v1 scored 0.120 — the FAIL is on the record; that's why it was replaced.
nodes.example_zh: scripts/eval_distill.py --report-real：看真库的卡片视图；质检门在 mock 与 hard 变体上分颜色。
nodes.example_en: scripts/eval_distill.py --report-real — the real-library card view; gates report mock and hard variants separately.

nodes.one_liner_zh: --context N 把同文件前后各 N 块一并带回，pack 默认 ±1
nodes.one_liner_en: --context N pulls in N neighbors on each side; pack ships ±1 by default
nodes.professional_zh: 答案经常被切在两块交界上。--context N（clamp ≤3）把同一文件里位置连续的前后各 N 块一并返回：邻块不额外占搜索结果名额，pack 模式默认 ±1 并做接缝去重、近重复折叠进主记录。SDK Agent 链与真实 token 矩阵在四档预算 × 三档上下文宽度上通过。
nodes.professional_en: Answers get cut at chunk boundaries. --context N (clamped ≤3) returns N positionally-continuous neighbors from the same file: neighbors take no extra result slots, pack ships ±1 by default with seam dedup and near-dup folding into the main record. Real SDK agent chains and a real-token matrix pass at four budgets × three context widths.
nodes.plain_zh: 「利润增长 12%」在上一段结尾，「原因是……」在下一段开头。这条规则把下一段也端上来，省得你自己猜去哪找。
nodes.plain_en: "Profit rose 12%" ends one chunk; "because…" starts the next. This fetches the next chunk so you don't have to guess where it went.
nodes.example_zh: search '退款期限' --context 2 --db lib.sqlite：每条命中前后各两块随行。
nodes.example_en: search '退款期限' --context 2 — two neighbors on each side ride along.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 每个命中的算术摆出来：语义 z、词覆盖、类型项各自多少
nodes.one_liner_en: Every hit shows its arithmetic: semantic z, coverage, kind term, itemized
nodes.professional_zh: --why 把每条命中的分数分解打印出来：语义 z 分、词覆盖率、类型加成、精确等级各自的贡献与最终融合值。每个数字可追问来源——这是「诚实契约」在打分子系统的落地面：不解释的分数不配被信任。
nodes.professional_en: --why prints each hit's arithmetic: semantic z, word coverage, kind bonus, exactness grade, and the fused total, itemized. Every number can be traced to its source — the honesty contract's face in the scoring subsystem: a number you can't interrogate is a number you can't trust.
nodes.plain_zh: 每条结果自带小票：这分怎么算的，一项一项列给你。不同意？每一项都能顺着查到机制。
nodes.plain_en: Every hit ships with a receipt: here's how the score was computed, line by line. Disagree? Each line traces to a mechanism you can inspect.
nodes.example_zh: search 'z_gate' --why --db evals/eval.sqlite：对比两条命中的分解，看词覆盖怎么压过语义。
nodes.example_en: search 'z_gate' --why --db evals/eval.sqlite — compare two hits' breakdowns; watch coverage beat semantics.
